as_told.title: Naval Intelligence offered Spielberg a deal after Jaws

plain: This story is about the film director Steven Spielberg. Brent Friedman, a guest on a podcast episode about Hollywood and UFOs, says that a man named Tobe Hooper told him, around 1995 in Newhall, California, that after Spielberg became a big name with the shark film Jaws, some men from Naval Intelligence, the Navy's spy branch, approached him and offered him a deal. In one telling Spielberg took the deal, and another version credits Hooper but does not say whether he did. People tell it because, if true, it would suggest the government helped shape Spielberg's later films about aliens.
